sections.title: Sound of Es
paragraphs: The letter name is (Es) /ɛs/. Its main sound is heard in the word (Sonne) /ˈzɔnə/, which means sun. This letter has three different sounds in German speech.

sections.title: How to say Es
paragraphs: For the first sound, place your tongue near the ridge behind your upper teeth. Push air out while your vocal cords vibrate. For the second sound, keep your tongue in the same place, but turn your voice off. For the third sound, push your lips forward and blow air past the tongue. Put your fingers on your throat to feel when your voice turns on.

sections.title: Spelling rules for Es
paragraphs: Before a vowel at the start of a syllable, say the letter as in (Sonne) /ˈzɔnə/. At the end of a syllable or before voiceless consonants, say the sound in (Haus) /haʊ̯s/. When the letter stands before p or t at the start of a syllable, make the sound in (Sport) /ʃpɔʁt/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not start words with the voiceless sound from sun. Use the buzzing sound from zoo instead. Do not use an ordinary s sound before p or t at word starts. Make the sound heard in ship instead.
